name: Muc nuong
summary: Mực nướng is squid grilled over charcoal, or mực một nắng when it has dried for a day. The grilled squid keeps a natural sweetness and a chewy bite.
origin: Cửa Lò, the beach of this city, and the night sidewalks in town. The city food-culture page’s record line for mực nháy Cửa Lò stays the city portal’s wording.
howToEat: At night, ask for charcoal. Ask for mực một nắng when you want the dried-one-day squid. The 3 May 2025 VnExpress page also names the squid steamed. Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch says the grilled squid keeps a natural sweetness and a chewy bite, eaten at seafood kitchens by the beach.
where: Cửa Lò, along đường Bình Minh, in the evening. In town, the sidewalk at night on the 24 November 2022 city page. Báo Nghệ An, 28 April 2023, names mực nướng on the mobile kiosks at Đào Tấn, 18:00–06:00 on the 27 April 2023 account. A beach-market street was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Muc nuong in Vinh — charcoal squid at night
seoDescription: Mực nướng is squid grilled over charcoal, or mực một nắng when it has dried for a day.
